summary: 3 E Network Technology Group Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting a private placement of 701,272 Class A ordinary shares at $1.42598 per share to an entity controlled by its CEO, raising $1,000,000 in gross proceeds. The transaction is an unregistered sale relying on Section 4(a)(2)/Regulation D, approved by the Audit Committee and board as a related-party transaction under Nasdaq rules. No placement agent or fees were involved. Proceeds are for working capital. This is a routine capital-raising transaction with no special-situation characteristics; no further strategic implications or risk-arb angle.
